meta.notes: Golden responses for the four issue-#75 parity comparisons. All input texts are fully synthetic. 'sparse' rows exclude the BOS/EOS positions (vLLM wraps the token_classify pooler in BOSEOSFilter), so each row has len(tokenize) - 2 entries. Dense vectors are unit-length (CLS pooling + L2). vLLM served fp16 (dtype=auto); expect ~1e-3-scale drift vs float32.
